name: netrunner-hud

language.title: Language / Langue
language.description: Language of the HUD, the events and the transcript headers: fr or en

ramCells.title: RAM cells
ramCells.description: Number of RAM cells in the band (5 to 10)

eventFrequency.title: Random events
eventFrequency.description: How often random Net events play: rare, normal or frequent (/netfx turns them off)

hpColor.title: HP color
hpColor.description: Color of the HP bar, as #RRGGBB

ramColor.title: RAM color
ramColor.description: Color of the RAM cells, as #RRGGBB
